summary: Final contest-readiness QA regression pass for CloudForge Cards v0.3.2 Phase 4B. Verified the three tiny QA fixes (README populated, em dashes removed from code comment + leaderboard placeholder) with zero regressions. Full backend regression suite (68/68 passed) run against the deployed preview URL. Frontend verified on desktop 1920px and mobile 390px: landing CTAs and hero-round-3/5/10 quick-start chips present, How to Play copy matches spec (title, 3/5/10-round intro, five steps, accessibility-note with Audio + Voice, scoring table with +30/+25/+20/+15/+10/+5), Leaderboard empty-cell placeholder now renders plain '-' (no em dashes anywhere on landing, how-to-play, or leaderboard), disclaimer 'Unofficial educational project. Not affiliated with Amazon Web Services.' present on landing footer, mobile 390px shows no horizontal overflow on / /how-to-play /play?rounds=3 /learn /learn/cards /learn/test /learn/match /leaderboard, mobile nav button present, Audio toggle localStorage 'cloudforge_audio_muted' persists after full reload (verified true), Voice toggle localStorage 'cloudforge_voice_style' cycles and persists (verified Calm after reload), 0 console errors across all navigations. Prior iteration_10 fully covered Play 3R end-to-end -> share-play-card BEFORE save-section -> leaderboard save -> admin cleanup, share-test-card, share-match-card, Copy result with success status, and native-share graceful hide in headless; no code changes to those paths since. App is stable and contest-ready.
tests_executed: Backend pytest full suite against https://cloudforge-cards.preview.emergentagent.com: 68/68 PASSED in 82.26s (backend_test, test_v026, test_v0261_leaderboard, test_v03_learn, test_v03_match, test_v03_phase3_e2e, test_v03_phase3_scoring, test_v03_test_mode). No ObjectId leaks, per-mode leaderboard, admin/owner delete gating, scoring engine, learn/test/match grading all intact.

Landing / desktop 1920: CTAs 'Start solo run', 'Study flashcards', 'Start test mode' present; hero quick-start chips hero-round-3 / hero-round-5 / hero-round-10 render '3 rounds', '5 rounds', '10 rounds'; footer disclaimer 'Unofficial educational project. Not affiliated with Amazon Web Services.' present; 0 em dashes on landing; 0 console errors.

How to Play desktop: title contains 'rules in 60 seconds', intro mentions 3-round/5-round/10-round, accessibility-note mentions Audio + Voice, scoring table exposes all six point ranges (+30/+25/+20/+15/+10/+5); 0 em dashes.
Leaderboard desktop: 0 em dashes in DOM; empty-mode cells render plain '-' (verified 4 placeholder cells for the two rows x two empty mode columns each in the current dataset); no visual breakage.
Mobile 390px overflow audit: scrollWidth == clientWidth on / /how-to-play /play?rounds=3 /learn /learn/cards /learn/test /learn/match /leaderboard (8/8 pages).
Audio persistence: localStorage 'cloudforge_audio_muted' == 'true' after toggle and remains 'true' after full page reload.
Voice persistence: localStorage 'cloudforge_voice_style' == 'Calm' after toggle and remains 'Calm' after full page reload.
Console error monitoring across every navigation above: 0 pageerrors, 0 console.error entries.
README verified: contains live app link https://cloudforge-cards.emergent.host/, GitHub repo link https://github.com/ChieNwosu/cloudforge-cards, and the unaffiliated-with-AWS disclaimer.

Frontend em dash grep across /app/frontend/src (jsx/js): 0 occurrences of U+2014. Backend em dash grep across /app/backend (py): only inside a test-file docstring header (backend_test.py line 1), not app code, not user-visible.
critical_code_review_comments: Leaderboard.jsx line 48: empty-cell placeholder now `-` (plain ASCII hyphen). Matches spec, keeps low-contrast muted styling that visually reads as an em dash without being one. Good.
README.md: 31 lines, populates live app URL + repo + tech stack + unaffiliated-with-AWS disclaimer. No em dashes in README. Aligned with contest-submission expectations.

Only remaining em dash in the repo is in backend/tests/backend_test.py line 1 docstring header 'iteration 3 — v0.2.5 scoring rewrite'. Not user-facing, not in shipped app code. Safe to leave, or scrub in a follow-up commit if the strict 'no em dashes' rule extends to test files.

Audio/Voice hooks (useAudioPreference + VoiceStyleToggle) write to localStorage synchronously on toggle and re-hydrate on mount; verified round-trip through a full page reload. No flicker or stale-state issues observed.
test_credentials: None required. ADMIN_TOKEN read from /app/backend/.env only; not exercised this pass (no rows created).
seed_data_creation: None. No leaderboard rows created this iteration (iteration_10 already validated the full create+save+admin-delete flow, and no code has changed in that path since). Local test machine localStorage was written (cloudforge_audio_muted=true, cloudforge_voice_style=Calm) as a persistence test; not cleared.
